onboarding_welcome_tagline: Private, encrypted expense tracking — by voice, by scanning a receipt, or straight from a bank notification.
onboarding_bullet1_title: Three ways to capture an expense
onboarding_bullet1_desc: Speak it to Vox Commander, scan a receipt with Vox Vision, or let a bank notification suggest one for you to approve.
onboarding_bullet2_desc: Set a budget per category and get alerted before you overspend; totals convert into your home currency.
onboarding_bullet3_desc: Your expenses never leave your phone unless you export them yourself.
onboarding_permissions_intro: Grant this so Vox Expenses can alert you about spending limits and confirm voice-captured expenses, even in the background. You can change it later in your device Settings.
permission_notif_desc: Needed for the spending-limit alert and the "expense saved" confirmation toast for voice-captured expenses.
permission_location_desc: Optional — lets a captured expense (voice, scan, or manual) prefill its location with your current city. You can always edit or clear it.
no_expenses_yet: No expenses yet. Tap + to add one.
discard_changes_message: You have unsaved changes. Save them or discard them?
delete_expense_message: This expense and its line items will be permanently deleted.
delete_item_message: This line item will be removed.
delete_attachment_message: This attached photo will be removed.
delete_attachment_group_message: Every photo in this group will be removed.
delete_category_message: Expenses in this category move to the main category. The expenses themselves are not deleted.
cleanup_confirm_message: The following field(s) contain only symbols or the text "null":
general_menu_desc: Fingerprint lock, default currency, calendar view, widget frame and the tutorial
theme_menu_desc: Dark mode, system colors and the highlight-today effect
require_fingerprint_desc: Expenses stay encrypted at rest; this gates reading them in the app and via VoxCommander
default_currency_desc: Assigned to a new expense when you haven't picked one
decimal_separator_desc: Which character amount/quantity/price fields use — independent of your device's language
debug_logging_desc: Write debug info to logcat — leave off unless you're troubleshooting an issue
debug_toasts_desc: Show on-screen popups for system events and background tasks
logs_settings_menu_desc: Debug logging and the captured log, to read, copy or share
backup_restore_menu_desc: Save everything to a file, restore it, and choose what a restore replaces
vat_display_desc: Show and edit per-item net/VAT/gross amounts when a receipt provides them
categories_settings_menu_desc: Add, edit or delete categories, and merge lookalikes with AI
merchant_category_memory_desc: After correcting a merchant's category the same way repeatedly, apply it automatically next time
voice_settings_menu_desc: The save confirmation, default category and auto-created categories
voice_save_toast: Toast when an expense is saved
voice_save_toast_desc: Show a confirmation (amount + category) when VoxCommander saves an expense
default_voice_category_desc: Expenses without a resolved category go here
auto_create_voice_category_desc: If a guessed category doesn't exist, create it (auto-colored) instead of falling back
retry_cleanup_no_saved_text: No saved scan text to retry — please rescan the receipt
rescan_lineitems_action: Rescan this photo for missing details
rescan_lineitems_already_in_progress: A rescan is already running for this expense — wait for it to finish
toast_lineitems_rescan_empty: Nothing new found in that photo
lineitems_suggestion_found: A rescan found line items for this receipt
possible_duplicate_items_warning: Possible duplicates — items highlighted in red have similar names, please check them
commander_required_message: This feature requires Vox Commander to be installed and configured
vision_required_message: This feature requires Vox Vision to be installed
auto_merge_categories_desc: Ask VoxCommander's AI to find near-duplicate categories for you to review
auto_merge_categories_need_two: Add at least 2 categories to use Auto-Merge
auto_merge_categories_sent_toast: Looking for duplicate categories — check back here shortly
scheduled_merge_desc: Look for duplicate categories automatically on a schedule (still requires your review before anything merges)
duplicate_entry_error: Duplicate entry — an identical expense already exists
expense_cleanup_settings_menu_desc: Duplicates, learned spellings, rewrite rules and notification templates
find_duplicate_expenses_desc: Ask VoxCommander's AI to find expenses that look like the same purchase logged twice
find_duplicate_expenses_need_two: Add at least 2 expenses to use this
find_duplicate_expenses_sent_toast: Looking for duplicates — check back here shortly
scheduled_dedup_desc: Also run the manual check above on a recurring schedule — uses whichever mode is selected there, and still stages suggestions for your review.
expense_cleanup_section_desc: Catch expenses that were saved twice — from voice, scan, manual entry, or captured bank notifications.
duplicate_check_automatic_desc: What runs every time a new expense is saved. Local merges obvious duplicates silently; AI-involving modes also fire a small, scoped check whose result waits for your review below.
duplicate_check_manual_desc: Which engine "Check for duplicates now" (and the schedule below) uses.
automatic_protection_review_only_desc: When on, an insert-time local-rule match is added to the review list below — the same way "Check for duplicates now" does — instead of merging automatically.
auto_accept_duplicate_merges_desc: When the scoped, insert-time AI check confirms a duplicate, merge it immediately instead of waiting for your review. Never affects the manual check or the schedule — those always stage suggestions for review.
duplicate_rules_desc: Each rule picks which fields must match, combined with AND (all of them) or OR (any of them). Multiple rules combine with the selector below.
duplicate_rule_needs_field_warning: Select at least one field before saving this rule.
duplicate_rule_match_mode_label: Match mode for this rule's text fields
duplicate_rule_auto_apply_desc: When off, this rule only runs for manual/scheduled checks and always waits for your review — never merges silently when a new expense is saved.
near_duplicate_merged_message: Merged with a similar existing expense.
currency_settings_menu_desc: Home currency, the currency of new accounts and where exchange rates come from
home_currency_desc: Reports convert mixed-currency expenses into this currency at report time
exchange_rate_api_key_desc: Free key from %1$s — only used when a report needs to convert a different currency
exchange_rate_service_missing: external_services.json is missing the exchange-rate entry
notification_capture_menu_desc: Which apps count as payment sources, auto-accept and the review queue
notification_capture_desc: Automatically detect payments from notifications of apps you pick below (e.g. your banking app) and propose them as expenses for you to review — nothing is created automatically unless you enable auto-accept below.
battery_optimization_warning: Some phones kill background apps aggressively, which can silently drop a payment notification before it's captured. Exempting this app from battery optimization keeps it running reliably in the background.
app_launch_management_warning: Some phones (Honor/Huawei in particular) have a separate 'App launch management' setting that can block this app from running in the background even with battery optimization disabled above — if payment notifications still aren't captured, check that setting too.
payment_source_apps_desc: Only notifications from apps checked below are ever inspected — everything else is ignored
installed_apps_empty_warning: No apps found. Some phones (Honor/Huawei in particular) have a separate 'Get installed apps' permission that must be granted before this list can populate — check Permissions / Other permissions on this app's info page.
auto_accept_notification_expenses_desc: Skip the review step — a successfully parsed notification is saved straight away as a normal expense (still editable afterward) instead of waiting for you to approve it.
spending_limits_desc: Checked daily; you'll get a notification the first time a limit is exceeded in a given week/month
calendar_view_desc: Browse expenses as a scrollable, month-paged calendar instead of a plain list
widget_border_enabled_desc: Draw an outline around each day's group of records in the home-screen widget.
attach_photo_on_scan: Process photo with AI on scan
attach_photo_on_scan_desc: Send the receipt photo to the AI alongside the recognized text (needs Vision's "send photo to AI" setting on too, and a multimodal engine configured)
attach_photo_on_retry: Process photo with AI on retry
attach_photo_on_retry_desc: Also send the photo when retrying a failed scan's cleanup, not just on the first attempt
auto_rescan_on_first_attachment: Auto-fill details from the first attached photo
auto_rescan_on_first_attachment_desc: Only when the expense currently has no photo at all — attaching another one later won't re-trigger it
multi_shot_enabled_for_attachments_desc: Shoot several pages in one go when attaching a photo (front+back, a multi-page document) instead of always a single shot
multi_shot_enabled_for_scan_desc: Capture several pages before creating the expense, combining their text into one read instead of only using the first page
auto_open_scanned_expense_desc: Jump straight to the new expense's edit screen for review as soon as a scanned receipt finishes processing, instead of staying on the list.
location_prefill_desc: Auto-fill an expense's location field with your current city (scan, voice, and manual entry). Turn off to stop this entirely, without revoking the location permission itself.
delete_all_expenses_desc: Permanently remove all expense records from this device
delete_all_confirm_message: This will permanently delete every expense record and line item. This action cannot be undone.
notifications_settings_menu_desc: Sound, volume, vibration and length of this app's alerts
notifications_system_default_desc: Use Android system settings for reminders and alerts
notifications_sound_desc: Play a sound when a notification arrives
schema_updates_desc: The services this app talks to are declared in files served by the repository below. What shipped with the app is the fallback.
schema_source_mixed: %1$d from the repository, %2$d shipped with the app
schema_use_remote_desc: Off runs exactly what this build shipped with, and deletes anything downloaded.
schema_using_bundled: Using the schemas shipped with the app
schema_reason_rejected: refused: it did not parse, or arrived empty
schema_reason_unsigned: refused: no valid signature covers it
locked_message: The expenses are locked. Unlock the app.
field_correction_memory_desc: When you fix a garbled word while editing a record, remember the fix and offer or apply it to future captures
remap_rules_desc: When a captured expense matches a rule, the rule rewrites other fields, alerts you, or both — your rules outrank learned ones, and both outrank the AI
remap_rule_needs_both_warning: A rule needs at least one match field with a value, and one consequence: a field to set or an alert
remap_learning_desc: When you rename the same field the same way in several records, a disabled rule is drafted for you to review and enable — it never acts on its own
rules_delete_all_message: This deletes every rule, including everything the app has learned. This cannot be undone.
remap_rule_proposed_badge: Proposed from your edits — review and enable
backup_import_mode_desc: How restoring a file reconciles it against what's already here. Only applies when Data is on.
backup_import_mode_caveat_merge: Safest: restores the file and deletes only records that existed when it was exported — anything created here afterwards is kept.
backup_import_mode_caveat_full_override: DELETES everything — including records created AFTER the backup — then restores only what the file contains.
backup_import_mode_caveat_additive: Never deletes anything — restoring the same file again DUPLICATES its records.
cleanup_duplicates_menu_desc: What counts as the same expense, and finding copies by hand or on a schedule
cleanup_corrections_menu_desc: Remembering your spelling fixes, learning speed, and suggest versus auto-apply
cleanup_remap_menu_desc: Rules that rewrite incoming expenses — learned from your edits or written by hand
cleanup_templates_menu_desc: The message shapes learned from bank notifications, and their status
template_list_empty: Nothing learned yet — templates appear here as you confirm notification expenses.
template_skeleton_pending: Text appears after this template's next message
cleanup_info_duplicates: Duplicate protection watches *new expenses* as they arrive and can also ~scan everything~ on demand or on a ~schedule~. Detection follows your *rules* and *time window*. Suspected duplicates appear below for *review* — you pick which record ~survives~, and nothing is !deleted! without your approval.
cleanup_info_corrections: When you *fix a garbled word* in a record, the fix is *remembered*. Once the same fix repeats enough times (your ~learning speed~), future records receive it ~automatically~ or as a *suggestion* — your choice. A word that ever gets ~two different fixes~ is considered ambiguous and is *never touched again*.
cleanup_info_remap: Rules act on new records the moment they are created: *WHEN* the fields you chose match a rule, *THEN* its other fields are ~set~, or it ~alerts you~, or both. You can *author rules* yourself, and your repeated similar edits surface as *proposals* that apply only after you *approve* them. Your own rules always outrank learned ones.
cleanup_info_templates: Each bank notification is reduced to its *sentence shape* — the fixed wording kept, amounts and names stripped. When you *confirm* records born from the same shape a few times, its *direction* becomes a learned fact and future identical messages ~skip the AI~. One ~contradiction~ !quarantines! the shape !for good!.
batch_manual_review_desc: If off, any duplicates found by the manual or scheduled check are merged automatically without confirmation.
find_duplicate_expenses_sent_auto_toast: Searching for duplicates... they will be merged automatically if found.
duplicate_check_local_auto_done_toast: Check complete. Duplicates were merged automatically.
rule_delete_confirm_message: "%1$s" will be deleted. Your records are not affected.
scan_model_use: How much AI reads a scan
scan_model_use_desc: The figures are read on the device either way. This decides how much is sent to a model.
scan_model_full_desc: The model may correct recognition, name the vendor and choose a category.
scan_model_header_footer_auto_desc: Items and totals stay on the device; the model answers for the rest and its answer is applied.
scan_model_header_footer_suggest_desc: The same, offered for you to accept rather than applied.
scan_model_none_desc: No text leaves the device. The vendor is read from the letterhead and the starred category is used.
default_category_cannot_delete: The main category cannot be deleted
vat_display_off_desc: Hidden. A scan that finds a breakdown will offer it once, on the record.
vat_display_auto_desc: Shown for records that carry a breakdown, hidden for the rest.
vat_display_on_desc: Shown on every record, empty or not.
vat_found_hidden: This document has a VAT breakdown. Add it?
scan_settings_menu_desc: What AI may read from a receipt, VAT detail and what happens after a scan
scan_zone_read: What is read from the document
notification_model_use_desc: What a captured notification is allowed to be sent to.
notification_model_full_desc: The notification's text goes to the engine, which reads the amount, the merchant and whether money left the account.
notification_model_none_desc: The amount is read on the device. What the message means is taken from templates you have already confirmed; anything else waits in review instead of being guessed.
flow_send_nothing_desc: Read here, and anything that cannot be proved waits for you.
flow_send_missing: Only what could not be worked out
flow_send_missing_desc: The narrowest question — and none at all when nothing is missing.
flow_send_head_desc: Asked about even where the reading already had an answer.
flow_send_everything_desc: The whole document, for the best answer it can give.
scan_fill_head: Fill in the main fields automatically
scan_fill_body: Fill in the line items automatically
flow_cannot_suggest: This app has nowhere to hold a suggestion, so an answer is written.
notification_assumed_direction_desc: With no model asked, a message shape you have never confirmed says nothing about which way the money went. Assume, and it is saved right away — correct it once on the record and that shape is taught; correct it twice and it answers on its own.
notification_assume_nothing_desc: An unconfirmed shape waits for you in review.
notification_assume_outgoing_desc: Saved as a payment. The usual case.
notification_assume_incoming_desc: Saved as an incoming amount, for an account that mostly receives.
capture_amountless_desc: Some senders announce a payment without saying how much. Keep those and ask you for the figure, instead of ignoring them. Off by default: an amount is what tells a payment from an advertisement.
recurring_payments_menu_desc: How repeated payments get noticed and confirmed, plus the due-date reminder
recurring_threshold_desc: How many times a payment must repeat before it is proposed as recurring — and how many missed due dates before dropping it is proposed. Off means never propose; you can still confirm one yourself.
recurring_missed_cycles: %d due dates passed with no payment
recurring_reminders_desc: A notification %d days ahead, once per bill. Only for payments you have confirmed.
recurring_gone_quiet: Due dates keep passing unpaid — has this stopped?
recurring_reminder_text_amount: %s is due %s — last time it was %s %s
recurring_missed_cycle_one: A due date passed with no payment
dismiss_on_capture_desc: Remove a payment notification from the shade once it has been captured — filed or waiting for approval. A message the app read and discarded is always left alone. Off by default: this cannot be undone.
vocabulary_banks_title: Words that name a bank or card scheme
vocabulary_banks_desc: A notification is two lines. When one of them names an issuer from this list, the other one is taken as the merchant. Switched-off words are ignored; your own are added to whatever the app supplies.
vocabulary_legal_desc: A line carrying one of these designators is the merchant outright, whatever else it contains. Not a list of shops — adding a shop name here does nothing.
vocabulary_rejected_present: That word is already in this list.
vocabulary_rejected_other_list: That word is in the other list. One word cannot mean both a company and a bank.
vocabulary_vendors_desc: A line naming one of these is the merchant, whatever else the message says — it outranks both lists below. Nothing is supplied here: these are the shops you deal with, not a list anyone could write for you.
bank_accounts_desc: Read from a card number, an IBAN or a masked ending. Nothing is guessed — the format either matches or it does not.
bank_accounts_none: None yet. One appears when a capture names a card or account and the switch above allows it.
default_account_currency: Currency for new cards and accounts
delete_account_message: The records that went through it are kept — they simply stop naming it.
add_account_hint: Card number, IBAN, or an ending like ••4535
add_account_unrecognised: Not a card number, an IBAN or a masked ending
tutorial_expenses_1_body: Speak it to Vox Commander, photograph a receipt with Vox Vision, or let a bank notification propose one. Typing it yourself is always there too.
tutorial_expenses_2_title: Nothing leaves unless you say so
tutorial_expenses_2_body: Every capture path has a dial: at one end the device reads what it can and asks nobody, at the other a model reads everything. You choose per path.
tutorial_expenses_3_body: Rename a shop once and the next message about it arrives under the name you use. Cards and accounts are read from the text itself and never guessed.
tutorial_expenses_4_title: Find anything, then report on it
tutorial_expenses_4_body: One control filters by category, card, currency, amount or date — and the same filter sits on Reports, so a report answers the question you are looking at.
replay_tutorial_desc: Shows the tour again, and lets every settings page explain itself once more.
hint_notification_capture_body: Only notifications from apps you tick here are ever inspected. What the app reads on its own — the amount, the bank, the card — never leaves the device; the switches above decide whether anything else may be sent.
hint_bank_accounts_body: These are read from the text itself: an IBAN, a card number, or a masked ending like ••4535, verified by checksum. Nothing is learned and nothing has to be taught — so there is no list supplied with the app, only the cards you have.
hint_categories_body: One category is the fallback: everything nothing else classified lands there. It sits at the top, above the divider. An icon on a category shows in the list, the pickers and the widget.
hint_cleanup_rules_body: Four pages of things the app learned or was told: which records count as duplicates, corrections it picked up from your edits, rename rules, and the message shapes it recognises.
hint_recurring_body: Payments that keep coming back are proposed here rather than declared by you. Confirming one shows its next arrival as a dotted row and reminds you before it is due.
hint_backup_body: A backup carries your records, categories, cards and rules. Restoring offers three modes; the safest one deletes only what existed when the backup was taken.
remap_rule_alert_desc: Post a notification when this rule recognises a payment. It can do this alongside setting fields, or instead of it
vocabulary_stop_desc: A message carrying one of these words is not read at all — no expense, no review entry, nothing sent anywhere. For refusals, reversals and anything else that is not a payment. The notification itself is left in place.
default_account_currency_desc: A card or account created from a capture starts in this currency. Left empty, it follows the app's own currency.
budget_and_limits_menu_desc: Per-account budgets, the widget's budget and spending limits by category
budgets_desc: What there is left to spend on an account, in each currency it holds. Cards under an account spend the account's budget. Nothing is kept as a running total — what is left is counted from your records every time it is shown.
budgets_no_accounts: No cards or accounts yet. One appears when a capture names one, or you can add it in From Notifications.
widget_budget_desc: The widget can name what is left to spend. Off shows nothing at all — a home screen is read on a lock screen and over shoulders.
widget_budget_none_yet: No account has a budget yet.
account_archived_desc: Kept for the records that name it and still counted by its account's budget, but no longer offered when choosing a card.
origin_legend: 👁 read · ☑ matched · ✨ answered by the AI
pending_captures_given_up_desc: Re-sent until the retry budget ran out and never answered. They will not be tried again on their own.
attention_dismiss_confirm: Nothing is deleted — these stop being counted, and anything new of the same kind will be counted again.
bulk_edit_explainer: Fields show what these records already say. Only what you change here is written; a field you leave alone stays as it is on each record.
archive_empty: Nothing archived. Records you put away wait here — outside every list, total and budget — until you restore or delete them.
archive_retention_forever: Never — keep until I delete them
archive_confirm_message: They leave every list, total and budget, and keep everything they say. You can restore them from the archive.
delete_forever_confirm_message: This cannot be undone — not the records, not their photos.
names_settings_menu_desc: The words that mark banks, shops and companies in captured text
learn_names_desc: A shop or a bank a capture read joins the lists below, so the next message naming it is read by it rather than worked out again. Everything learned stays visible here, and can be switched off or removed.
